# Audio test fixtures

Each file is "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", spoken, 3.8 seconds.

| File | Format |
| :- | :- |
| `fox_44k_stereo.ogg` | Original, Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz stereo |
| `fox_8k_stereo.wav` | 16-bit WAV, 8 kHz stereo |
| `fox_24k_mono.wav` | 16-bit WAV, 24 kHz mono |
| `fox_16k_mono.wav` | 16-bit WAV, 16 kHz mono |
| `fox_8k_mono.wav` | 16-bit WAV, 8 kHz mono |
| `fox_16k_mono.flac` | FLAC, 16 kHz mono |
| `fox_44k_stereo.mp3` | MP3, 128 kbit/s, 44.1 kHz stereo |

- **Source:** [Audio Sample - The Quick Brown Fox Jumps Over The Lazy Dog.ogg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Audio_Sample_-_The_Quick_Brown_Fox_Jumps_Over_The_Lazy_Dog.ogg) on Wikimedia Commons
- **Author:** Russell Sacobie (RussmanJr)
- **Licence:** [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- **Changes:** the `.ogg` is unchanged. The other files were converted from it with ffmpeg.

This licence covers the audio files in this folder only.
